title: Evaluate WCAG Mapping Review Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a modal focus defect, map keyboard and focus-order criteria only where the observed journey supports them, list dialog semantics separately, and avoid claiming full page conformance.
acceptance_criteria: A criterion matrix containing version, level, applicability, user impact, observed evidence, status, and required follow-up.
Direct semantic, keyboard, visual, content, or runtime evidence supporting each confirmed mapping.
A separate list of automated signals, advisory techniques, manual checks, and out-of-scope compliance questions.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject criterion failures inferred only from a tool identifier or generic checklist.
Reject WCAG conformance or legal-compliance conclusions from a component-level mapping review.
